login.title: Sign in
login.description: One account for every role you have.
login.emailHint: We’ll email you a 6-digit sign-in code. No password needed.

signup.title: Join the boxing <hl>community.</hl>
signup.description: One account for fighters, coaches, gyms and brands. Add roles any time — your training stays yours.
signup.haveAccount: Already have an account? <link>Sign in</link> · By continuing you accept the Terms and Privacy Policy.

roles.title: How will you use SimpleFit?

fighter.title: Fighter
fighter.description: Train, track progress and connect. Free forever for the core app.

coach.title: Coach
coach.description: Manage fighters, programs and fight camps. Free up to 3 fighters.

gym.title: Gym / Club
gym.description: Manage members, coaches and your boxing business.

sponsor.title: Sponsor / Brand
sponsor.description: Partner with the boxing community — challenges, events, gyms.

roles.note: You can be all of these at once. Workspaces keep a gym’s data separate from your personal training.

account.title: Create your SimpleFit account
account.hint: We’ll email you a 6-digit code to verify this address. No password needed.
account.legal: By continuing you accept the Terms and Privacy Policy.

identity.title: One identity
identity.body: Fighter, coach, gym owner and sponsor are roles on the same account. Add or remove roles any time.

account.sponsor: Brand or sponsor? <link>Apply as a sponsor</link> — no account needed to start.

consents.terms: I accept the Terms and Privacy Policy

next.title: What happens next
next.note: Coach → 6 steps then plan · Gym → 14-step setup · Sponsors apply separately.

code.label: 6-digit code
code.neverShare: Never share this code. SimpleFit staff will never ask you for it.

signIn.title: Enter your sign-in code
signIn.description: If there’s a SimpleFit account for {email}, a 6-digit sign-in code is on its way. It expires in 10 minutes.

notices.sent: Code sent. It expires in 10 minutes — check spam if you don’t see it.
notices.resent: We sent a new code. It expires in 10 minutes.
notices.invalid: That code isn’t right. Check the digits and try again.
notices.expired: This code has expired. Send a new one to sign in.
notices.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.

registration.title: Verify your email
registration.description: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. It expires in 10 minutes.
registration.preferSignIn: Prefer to sign in? <link>Sign in with a code</link>
registration.links: Wrong address? <change>Change email</change> · Already have an account? <signIn>Sign in</signIn>
registration.linkInfo: You can also verify with the Verify email link in the same email. If you open it on another device, this page will ask for a new code before you continue — the link never signs anyone in.

notices.resent: We sent a new code. It expires in 10 minutes.
notices.invalid: That code isn’t right. Check the digits and try again.
notices.expired: This code has expired. Send a new one to verify your email.
notices.verified-elsewhere: This email was verified from another device. This device isn’t signed in yet — send a new code to {email} to continue here.
notices.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again shortly.

preview.label: Verify your email
preview.body: Enter it where you’re signing up, or use the Verify email link. Didn’t ask for this? Ignore this email.

verifyEmail.noSession: This link only verifies your email address. It doesn’t sign you in — not on this device, and not on the one where you started.
verifyEmail.useThisDevice: Want to use this device? <link>Sign in</link>

verified.title: Email verified
verified.body: Your email address is verified. This doesn’t sign you in here or on any other device. If you started signing up somewhere else, go back there — it will ask for a new code before you continue.

already.title: Email already verified
already.body: There’s nothing more to do here. To continue, sign in with a 6-digit code — on this device or on the one where you started.

expired.title: This link has expired
expired.body: Verification links and codes expire after 10 minutes. Go back to where you started signing up and send a new code.

error.title: We couldn’t check this link
error.body: Check your connection and try again.
